headline.en: Flick has used three left-backs in two Liga games
headline.es: Flick ha usado tres laterales zurdos en dos partidos

summary.en: Xavi Espart started at Elche and mixed the Athletic match between the flank and midfield. Cancelo came on late. Balde is in the squad and has not started. Flick has to pick one of them against Rayo.
summary.es: Espart salio en Elche. Cancelo entro tarde. Balde no ha sido titular. El Rayo obliga a elegir.

body.en: Flick has given minutes to three players on the left of defence. Espart started at Elche. Against Athletic he also played inside. Cancelo came off the bench. Balde trained and was in the squad after saying he would stay, but he has not started. Rayo attack the space behind full-backs. That is why the choice for Monday matters. Espart is the promoted option. Cancelo is the senior option. Balde is the fastest option if Flick wants recovery speed. Two matches are not enough to name a first-choice left-back for the season. They are enough to show Flick is willing to use all three.

headline.en: After Feyenoord, Barcelona go to Galatasaray and PSG in October
headline.es: Despues del Feyenoord, el Barca va a Galatasaray y al PSG en octubre

summary.en: The list after Feyenoord is Galatasaray away, Paris Saint-Germain away, Aston Villa at home and Manchester City at home. SPORT called that stretch the hard block. Those games are why the club signed extra senior players this summer.
summary.es: Despues del Feyenoord: Galatasaray y PSG fuera, Villa y City en casa. SPORT lo marco como el bloque dificil.

body.en: Feyenoord at home is the first European night. The harder games come later. In October Barcelona go to Galatasaray and then to Paris in consecutive away weeks. Aston Villa visit in November. Manchester City visit in December. SPORT said that run, close to the Clasico dates, is the hard part of the league phase. Eric Garcia already misses Feyenoord. Gavi and Rodri are being managed. Yamal's minutes are going up. The summer signings exist for those weeks. Rayo on Monday does not change the list. It only decides who is fit when the list starts.

headline.en: Barcelona are selling academy players who are not in Flick's side
headline.es: El Barca vende canteranos que no estan en el once de Flick

summary.en: MARCA put Toni Fernandez near five million to Venezia and Alvaro Cortes at 3.5 million to Antwerp. Other reports keep Fernandez nearer four million with a buy-back. Hector Fort already left on similar terms.
summary.es: Fernandez cerca de cuatro o cinco millones al Venezia. Cortes 3,5 al Amberes. Fort ya salio igual.

body.en: Deco is selling players Flick is not picking. Fernandez is close to Venezia. Cortes is close to Antwerp. Fort has already gone. The fees are small next to Gordon and Rodri. The contracts include buy-backs or a share of a later sale. That income helps the 1:1 ratio. In the same week, Xavi Espart was promoted. The club is not emptying the academy. It is moving the players Flick wants onto the first-team list and selling the ones who will not play. The fees only help if they land before the next registration date.
